key_insights: The agent is classified as Tier Omega (transcendent) across all 20 domains — no skill below Ω-level
The prompt blends mythological storytelling with concrete technical specifications (MCP, OS scripts, API integrations)
9 domains have 10,000+ years experience; 11 domains have 1,000+ years — suggesting differentiation between core and extended competencies
Ethics framework is comprehensive: 10 immutable restrictions + 10 always-do rules with a 3-tier decision engine
The system prompt serves dual purposes: agent definition for LLM AND documentation for human readers
MCP Server architecture section provides fully functional Python template code, not just conceptual description
Content rules emphasize human-like writing with variability, imperfection, specificity, and rhythm — anti-AI-detection by design
The prompt includes complete PowerShell/Bash automation scripts for Windows and Linux maintenance — operational readiness
Alt-Three mode and X10 Think mode provide meta-cognitive frameworks for problem-solving beyond standard outputs
The prompt reveals a sophisticated orchestration system underneath — the Harness Orchestrator with fan-out architecture
